description: Welcome to Laiba’s Ghost Probes , a global team registered for the Universal Event at the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge! Led by Laiba Mubasher from the Institute of Space Science, University of the Punjab, we are tackling the Abandoned But Not Forgotten challenge. Using official records from the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA), we tell the stories of NASA’s silent pioneers—from Voyager 1 and Pioneer 10 to Spirit, Opportunity, and Ingenuity.
